 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. REGIS LE BRIS has made big calls in defence and on the wing ahead of Sunderland 's Premier League game at Coventry City.
 With Nordi Mukiele unavailable because of the neck problem he sustained in last weekend's draw with Leeds United, Le Bris has recalled Omar Alderete to the starting XI despite the centre-half's struggles in the recent defeat at Bournemouth.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Alderete will partner Luke O'Nien at the heart of the back four, with Kevin Danso on the substitutes' bench. Trai Hume continues at right-back, with Thomas Meunier on the bench.
 Further forward, Le Bris has opted to stick with the same two wide players that started against Leeds last weekend, meaning Chris Rigg will line up on the right-hand side with Nilson Angulo on the left.
 Jocelin Ta Bi is only named amongst the substitutes despite having set up all three of Sunderland's goals in their midweek Carabao Cup win over Brentford, with Chemsdine Talbi also selected amongst the replacements.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Brian Brobbey continues to lead the line for the Black Cats , with Wilson Isidor on the substitutes' bench.
 COVENTRY (4-2-3-1): Rushworth; van Ewijk, Mfuni, Pinnock, Dasilva; Yirenkyi, Torp; Sakamoto, Rudoni, Gboho; Awoniyi. 
 Subs: Bentley, Latibeaudiere, Kesler-Hayden, Grimes, Hamer, Mason-Clark, Cherif, Thomas-Asante, Simms. 
 SUNDERLAND (4-2-3-1): Roefs; Hume, O'Nien, Alderete, Reinildo; Xhaka, Sadiki; Rigg, Le Fee, Angulo; Brobbey. 
 Subs: Ellborg, Methalie, Danso, Ahoka, Talbi, Fofana, Meunier, Isidor, Jocelin.
